trigger.reason: PUB-P2E06 showed that the 103 Reference RETRY_LOCAL_BAL cases do not clear when max_iterations alone increases from 16 to 64, while dt times the maximum local residual remains near 1e-16 to 1e-15 cm and the residual-rate scale worsens as dt decreases. P2E06 explicitly requires a separate Reference-only decomposition before any replacement calibration matrix or tolerance-policy proposal.

scientific_question: For the exact 103 P2E06 Reference local-balance first-failure states, can the failed internal HeadCalc residual be reconstructed from its actual internal storage and flux terms, and is the observed residual scale numerically distinguishable from finite-representation and cancellation effects at the existing strict 1e-12 cm/day criterion?

scope.domain: exact immutable P2E03/P2E04/P2E06 six-material x three-Se x three-forcing x three-requested-dt matrix

dependency_locks.policy: Lock only dependencies that define the P2E07 Reference experiment. Do not lock the entire src tree, because unrelated admitted successor work must remain composable.

stage_A_exact_replay.rule: Reproduce the exact P2E06 first-failure classification before interpreting any new diagnostic.

stage_B_internal_residual_reconstruction.rule: For each exact RETRY_LOCAL_BAL first-failure state, use the failed internal Reference workspace rather than the fail-closed public candidate state. Reconstruct the residual at the maximum-absolute-residual node from internal provider_theta, request base theta, fixed explicit source/sink terms, fixed boundary fluxes, the frozen SwKimpl=0 conductivity state, and final HeadCalc face gradients.
stage_B_internal_residual_reconstruction.boundary_rule: Use the exact HeadCalc vector_F sign convention for top, internal and bottom nodes. Do not infer a physical decomposition from the fail-closed public candidate state.

stage_C_representation_and_cancellation_.rule: Characterize numerical distinguishability without changing the solver. All floor quantities retain cm/day units.
observations: component L1 rate scale, sum of absolute reconstructed algebraic terms
real64 versus higher-precision recomposition difference using the same stored component inputs
spread across all summation orders of the nonzero reconstructed real64 components
dt times each floor quantity in cm
existing compartment tolerance divided by the local estimated floor
stage_C_representation_and_cancellation_.interpretation: The estimated floor is a diagnostic lower-resolution scale for this frozen experiment, not a new solver tolerance and not proof that any one arithmetic operation is the sole cause.

stage_D_calibration_validity_criterion.criterion: A local strict Reference balance criterion is not numerically distinguishable for calibration at a diagnosed state when estimated_local_floor >= configured_compartment_balance_tolerance. It is numerically distinguishable by this diagnostic only when estimated_local_floor < configured_compartment_balance_tolerance.
stage_D_calibration_validity_criterion.scope_boundary: This is a calibration-validity diagnostic for the frozen Reference experiment. It does not authorize changing the production or Reference tolerance and it is not a RossFast admissibility criterion.
report: count of LOCAL_BAL states with estimated_floor >= tolerance by requested dt
distribution of tolerance/floor margins by requested dt
distribution of residual/floor ratios by requested dt
whether the P2E06 1/dt pattern is reproduced by the storage quantization component
whether cancellation/summation effects add a comparable, smaller or larger floor

hypotheses.H_internal_state: The failed internal workspace contains a nonzero storage-rate term even where the fail-closed public candidate used by the earlier P2E06 max-node decomposition showed zero candidate-state storage change.
hypotheses.H_storage_resolution: The storage input quantization floor increases approximately with 1/dt and is of the same order as a material fraction of the observed LOCAL_BAL residuals.
hypotheses.H_cancellation: The residual is formed by cancellation among materially larger storage and flux terms, but the relative contribution of final summation-order rounding is to be measured rather than assumed dominant.
hypotheses.H_validity: Some or all strict 1e-12 cm/day LOCAL_BAL classifications may fall at or below the estimated numerical resolution scale; the exact count is an outcome, not a pass condition.

required: finite and dimensionally consistent component diagnostics
residual reconstruction closure checked and reported
no production/reference source or tolerance change
full relevant canonical preservation gates on the resulting PR

interpretation_boundaries: Do not call finite precision the cause solely because residuals are close to an ulp-derived scale.
Do not treat higher-precision recomposition of already rounded state variables as an exact physical reference solution.
Do not derive a replacement tolerance by fitting the observed failures.
Do not remove or relabel immutable P2E03/P2E04/P2E06 cases.
Do not inspect RossFast discrepancies in this workunit.
A negative result remains valid evidence and must not be repaired by widening scope.
next_permitted_action: Implement only the publication diagnostic harness and its CI wrapper against these frozen dependencies. Persist the observed result before proposing any calibration matrix or numerical-policy workunit.
